summary: Credicorp Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose the exchange rate used for its upcoming dividend payment. The Peruvian Superintendence of Banking, Insurance and AFP set the rate at S/3.4158 per USD as of June 10, 2026, resulting in a dividend of US$14.6379 per share (equivalent to S/50.00). The payment will occur on June 12, 2026, pursuant to a board decision from April 23, 2026. This is a routine dividend distribution notification with no special-situation elements such as a tender, acquisition, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer's periodic material event report, it is not a special situation filing. There are no deal terms to report.
